column1: manifest§The ship's manifest listed cargo that never arrived.§船上的**载货清单**列了从未到岸的货物。
manipulative§A manipulative question contains its own answer.§**操弄性**的问题里已经藏着它自己的答案。
mannered§Mannered acting in the first reel gives way to something honest.§第一卷里**做作**的表演后来变成了某种真诚。
masterful§A masterful silence let the other side talk itself out.§一段**高明**的沉默让对方自己把话说尽。
materialist§The materialist explanation is complete and unsatisfying.§**唯物**的解释很完整，却不令人满足。
maternal§Maternal care in this species lasts eleven weeks.§这个物种的**母兽**照料期为十一周。
matriarchal§Elephant herds are matriarchal and led by the oldest female.§象群是**母系**的，由最年长的母象带领。
maudlin§Two drinks in, the toast turned maudlin.§喝了两杯之后，祝酒词变得**伤感**起来。
maverick§A maverick is only celebrated once the herd catches up.§**特立独行**者只有在群体赶上来之后才被称颂。
meager§A meager pension and a good library kept him going.§**微薄**的养老金和一座好图书馆支撑着他。
meaning§The meaning of the word has narrowed twice since 1800.§这个词的**含义**自一八〇〇年以来收窄了两次。
meddle§Frost meddles with the foundations every single winter.§霜冻每一个冬天都在**扰动**地基。
meddler§History is kinder to the meddler than to the bystander.§历史对**多事者**比对旁观者更宽厚。
mediate§Language mediates everything we think we see directly.§语言**中介**了一切我们自以为直接看到的东西。
mediator§A mediator's first job is to slow everybody down.§**调解人**的首要任务是让所有人慢下来。
medicinal§A medicinal smell hung in the corridor for weeks.§一股**药味**在走廊里飘了好几周。
mediocre§Mediocre work delivered on time beats brilliant work that never arrives.§按时交付的**平庸之作**胜过永远不来的杰作。
mediocrity§Institutions protect against disaster and against excellence alike.§制度既防灾难，也防卓越，最后剩下**平庸**。
meditate§He meditated for an hour each morning and told no one.§他每天早上**打坐**一小时，从不告诉别人。
meditation§The book is a meditation on repair rather than on loss.§这本书是关于修复而非关于失去的**沉思**。
melancholy§Melancholy is not depression, and the distinction matters.§**忧郁**不是抑郁，这个区别很要紧。
melee§In the melee somebody made off with the minutes.§**混乱**中有人把会议记录拿走了。
mellifluous§A mellifluous reading can hide a bad translation.§流畅**甜美的**朗读可以掩盖糟糕的翻译。
melodious§The name is melodious and impossible to spell.§这个名字很**悦耳**，却怎么也拼不对。
melodrama§Strip the melodrama and a real grievance remains.§剥掉那些**戏剧化**的成分，剩下的是真实的不满。
membranous§The wing case is membranous and folds under the shell.§这层翅鞘是**膜质**的，折叠在硬壳下面。
memorable§Memorable is not the same as good, as any jingle proves.§**难忘**不等于好，任何广告曲都能证明这一点。
mendacious§A mendacious footnote is worse than no footnote.§一条**撒谎**的脚注比没有脚注更糟。
mendacity§Mendacity on small things predicts it on large ones.§在小事上**撒谎**，预示着大事上也会。
mentor§Being a mentor is mostly reading things twice.§做**良师益友**，多半就是把东西读两遍。
mercenary§Mercenary troops changed sides twice in one campaign.§**雇佣兵**在一次战役中两度倒戈。
mercurial§Mercurial weather here makes any forecast a guess.§这里**天气多变**，任何预报都是猜测。
merge§Two rivers merge below the bridge and change colour.§两条河在桥下**汇合**，颜色也变了。
merriment§Merriment is hard to fake and harder to schedule.§**欢乐**很难装出来，更难安排。
metaphorical§He meant it metaphorically and the paper printed it literally.§他是**打比方**，报纸却按字面印了出来。
meteor§A meteor shower is best watched lying down.§**流星**雨最好躺着看。
methodical§Methodical is slower on Monday and much faster by Friday.§**有条不紊**的做法周一慢些，到周五就快得多。
meticulous§Meticulous notes are how a project survives a change of staff.§**细致**的笔记是项目挺过人员变动的方式。
metropolis§From the hill the metropolis looks like a single grey object.§从山上望去，这座**大都市**像一整块灰色的东西。
miff§A miffed silence lasted through the whole meal.§一顿饭都在**赌气**的沉默中度过。
migration§Migration of the term into everyday speech took thirty years.§这个术语**进入日常口语**用了三十年。
milestone§A milestone by the road still gives the distance in miles.§路边的**里程碑**仍然以英里标注距离。
mimic§A good mimic exaggerates one thing and leaves the rest alone.§好的**模仿**者只夸大一点，其余原样不动。
mindful§Be mindful that the earlier edition uses a different numbering.§请**留意**早先的版本用的是另一套编号。
minimize§Do not minimize a risk in order to keep a schedule.§不要为了保住进度而**低估**风险。
miraculous§The survival of the archive is close to miraculous.§这批档案能保存下来近乎**奇迹**。
misapplication§Misapplication of a good rule causes more harm than a bad rule.§好规则的**误用**比坏规则造成的伤害更大。
misbehave§The instrument misbehaves above forty degrees.§这台仪器在四十度以上就**不正常**了。
mischievous§A mischievous rumor is harder to correct than a malicious one.§**淘气的**谣言比恶意的更难更正。
misconception§The misconception survives because the truth is duller.§这个**误解**之所以存活，是因为真相更乏味。
miscreant§The miscreants turned out to be two schoolboys and a ladder.§那些“**歹徒**”原来是两个学生和一把梯子。
miser§A miser of words, he wrote three sentences a day.§他**惜字如金**，一天写三句。
misery§Misery is not improved by being explained.§**痛苦**不会因为被解释而好转。
misgiving§His misgivings were recorded and then overruled.§他的**疑虑**被记录下来，随后被驳回。
misguide§A confident guidebook can misguide a whole generation of walkers.§一本自信的指南可能**误导**整整一代徒步者。
mishandle§Mishandled once, the negative was never printable again.§底片一经**不当处理**，就再也冲印不出来了。
mishap§The mishap was minor and the paperwork was not.§这次**小意外**无关紧要，文书工作却不然。
misinterpret§To misinterpret generously is still to misinterpret.§善意的**误解**仍然是误解。
misjudge§She misjudged the audience and not the material.§她**看错**的是听众，不是素材。
misnomer§"Common cold" is a misnomer twice over.§“普通感冒”这个说法有两重**不确切**。
misrepresent§Do not misrepresent silence as agreement.§不要把沉默**歪曲**成同意。
missive§The missive was sealed with wax and delivered by hand.§这封**公文**用蜡封缄，由人亲手送达。
misstate§He misstated his own position and then defended the misstatement.§他把自己的立场**说错**了，随后又为这个错误辩护。
mitigate§Nothing mitigates a delay like telling people early.§没有什么比早点告知更能**缓解**延误。
mitigator§A written record is the best mitigator of a bad memory.§书面记录是**应对记性差**的最佳办法。
mock§They built a mock ward to train the staff.§他们搭了一间**模拟**病房来培训员工。
mockery§To make a mockery of a rule is to invite its replacement.§**嘲弄**一条规则，就是在招来它的替代品。
